notes.title: Demo Bug Fixes 1.0
notes.content:
In this new build, I fixed the following bugs:


 Flashlight flickering constantly
 Inability to exit from puzzle games
 Persistent heartbeat sound in the light


Additions:

 Ammo items now provide double the ammo
 Lockpick items now provide double the amount
 Added new tooltips
 Added a damage effect for when the player takes hits


If you find any bugs, please report them on our Discord server!
